name: LLM4Mat-bench
description: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used in materials science. However, little attention has been given to benchmarking and standardized evaluation for LLM-based materials property prediction, which hinders progress. We present LLM4Mat-Bench, the largest benchmark to date for evaluating the performance of LLMs in predicting the properties of crystalline materials.
reputation: A recent, specialized benchmark for LLM-based crystalline materials property prediction, with limited but growing adoption in the materials AI community.
notes: Specialized scientific benchmark; likely small-to-moderate scale and not yet widely standardized across the community.
